banking-economy.title: HDFC Bank CEO Jagdishan’s refusal to overhaul bank fueled surprise exit as chairman pushed for changes
banking-economy.summary: HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan will depart after his term ends next month. New chairman Rajiv Kumar sought aggressive changes and executive replacements. Jagdishan resisted some proposals and decided not to seek reappointment. The bank now faces a swift search for a new leader. This departure adds to recent turmoil and stock market struggles.

banking-economy.title: InsuranceDekho, RenewBuy combine to create AI Insurance Platform
banking-economy.summary: InsuranceDekho and RenewBuy are merging to create an AI-enabled insurance distribution platform with over ₹6,600 crore in premiums, 600,000+ digital partners and coverage across 98.57% of India’s pincodes. The combined business will operate under the InsuranceDekho brand, with Ankit Agrawal as CEO, and will offer motor, health, life and commercial insurance products.
